intent: A Victorian mourning gown in black wool and slate trimmed with bone lace: a veiled broad-brimmed hat with a big bow, a high-necked bodice over a bustled waist and a wide tiered bell skirt, which reads from the high camera as a black bell under a hat, edged with pale collar, cuffs and petticoat.
reason: The Victorian mourning gown, a veiled broad-brimmed hat over a high-necked black bodice, bustle and tiered skirt, is the most gothic and sits best in the night-bound world.
first_fix: All black and slate, it can merge into the night from the high camera: lift the bone lace trims a step so its outline holds on dark ground.
